content.title: How to watch Guardians vs. Braves: TV channel and streaming options for April 12
content.text: The Atlanta Braves and Cleveland Guardians play a rubber match on Sunday at 7:20 p.m. ET, with the series deadlocked at 1-1. Chris Sale (2-1, 3.94 ERA) will start for the Braves, who are 9-6 this season and first in the NL East. Tanner Bibee (0-1, 3.29 ERA) is starting for the Guardians, who are 9-6 and first in the AL Central.How to watch Cleveland Guardians vs. Atlanta Braves Venue: Truist Park Time: 7:20 p.m. ET TV: NBC/Peacock Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. He has also tallied 16 RBIs (2nd in MLB) and has scored 14 runs. In 68 plate appearances, he has recorded a .328 BA, .397 OBP and .607 SLG with a 7.4% walk rate and a 16.2% strikeout rate. In 66 plate appearances, Matt Olson has slashed .281/.379/.614 this season. He has hit four long balls (13th in MLB) and driven in 10 runs with a strikeout rate of 30.3% and a walk rate of 13.6%. He has come around to score 11 times. Cleveland’s Chase DeLauter is slashing .271/.345/.646 this season with five home runs (4th in MLB), 12 RBIs (16th in MLB) and an OPS of .991 (14th in MLB). He has an 18.2% strikeout rate and a 10.9% walk rate in 55 plate appearances, and he has scored nine total runs. In 65 plate appearances, José Ramírez has slashed .175/.277/.333 this season. He has hit two long balls and driven in seven runs with a strikeout rate of 13.8% and a walk rate of 12.3%. He has stolen four bases on four attempts and has scored five runs.
